title: 매직아이템 속성에 관해서...
bodyHtml:
uoss에 보다가. 잼있는걸 발견했습니다

각 매직 옵션의 최소 최대 수치인데요

Stat Bonuses
Stat Bonuses increase the wearer's basic stats. Stat Bonuses come in the range from 1 to 8 points.

Strength Bonus – Increases a player’s strength while the object is equipped.
Intelligence Bonus – Increases a player’s intelligence while the object is equipped.
Dexterity Bonus – Increases a player’s dexterity while the object is equipped.

Applies to: Jewelry
Note: Some items that used to have the 'Bless' spell effect attached to them have incorrectly been converted to items that add 10 points to Str, Int and/or Dex. This is believed to be a bug and will most probably be fixed in an upcoming patch.

....

1-8까지 왔다갔다 하는겁니다.... 아래 어떤분이 인트증가 11 짜리 바지 날렸다고 하는데

혹시..

매직 아이템 속성이 중복되지 않을까요?

http://uo.stratics.com/content/arms-armor/magicarmsarmor.shtml

저기 가셔서 자기가 가직 좋은 매직무기중..

속성이 중복된거 같다! 라고 생각하시는분 아이템 스샷좀.. 왼쪽 아이템 스샷란에다 올려주세요
